rationale: The chunks address one sub-issue (age-transition structure and continuity mode in 1.2.3–1.2.4, plus Test of Time feature allowing same-civ play), but do not ground the player's core complaints about stripped civilization-building mechanics, lack of world customization at game start, or unrecognizable leaders. An ideal responder could acknowledge design evolution but would lack material to directly address the three main grievances.
